name: e9-jupiter-plateau
notes: Load the save where the player has just taken Jupiter and run a year. Vanilla has no escalation tied to losing a gas giant: fleets trickle back piecemeal or not at all.
expect: vanilla FAILS (no counteroffensive of meaningful size); the fixed AI mobilises and strikes Jupiter in force
asserts: max([r['scv'] for r in events('transfer', toSystem='Jupiter')] or [0]) >= 1.5 * faction(first, 'ResistCouncil').get('scvBySystem', {}).get('Jupiter', 0)
